answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy employs Proof-of-Physical-Location via hardware attestations. Agents authenticate by solving latency challenges routed through physical edge anchors like a harbor wharf, a knoll relay, and a sable sensor node. This binds virtual identities to unique silicon hardware, forcing attackers to deploy distinct physical machines rather than virtual instances, driving the cost per fake identity to full hardware acquisition expenditure.
